# Philosophy of Software Design rules (Maciej Ciemborowicz)

Design rules inspired by John Ousterhout's book for module boundaries and APIs.

- Source: https://github.com/ciembor/agent-rules-books
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ciembor/agent-rules-books/main/a-philosophy-of-software-design/SKILL.md
- Author: Maciej Ciemborowicz
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/philosophy-of-software-design-rules-maciej-ciemborowicz-d0a0c70d

When a task involves module or API design, Claude reads and applies a condensed rule set inspired by A Philosophy of Software Design: deep modules, information hiding, lower cognitive load and fewer shallow interfaces. A longer version of the rules is included for harder tradeoffs. The rules are the author's summary of the book's ideas, not the book's text.

**Try asking:**
- "Review this module's API for shallow interfaces and leaked details"
- "Redesign this service class to hide more complexity"
- "Apply Ousterhout's principles to this refactor plan"

**Source:** [ciembor/agent-rules-books](https://github.com/ciembor/agent-rules-books/tree/HEAD/a-philosophy-of-software-design) · MIT · by Maciej Ciemborowicz
